mechanism_comparison.polynomial_form: The distance product is |P(t w_j)| for the monic circle-rooted polynomial P(z)=product_k(z-w_k).
mechanism_comparison.quantifier_obstruction: ONE-SPOKE exchanges pointwise availability for a single index valid over a continuum: it asserts existence of j such that every t is safe. The certificate supplies, for each j, one exact t_j that is unsafe.
mechanism_comparison.self_inversive_boundary: Circle-rooted P is self-inversive up to a unimodular scalar, but reciprocal symmetry alone supplies no upper bound on |P| along these five rays.
mechanism_comparison.openness: Because the five violations occur at fixed t_j with strict margins, their simultaneous persistence is a direct finite intersection of open conditions; common scaling follows from degree-five homogeneity.
mechanism_comparison.packet_consolidation: The packet row two_safe_origin_spokes_counterexample uses the same five directions at radius 99999/100000. It is a weaker interior specialization of this zero-safe-spoke countermodel and must remain subordinate rather than becoming a parallel mechanism.
